description: Test of dusting a PIN pad with the fingerprint kit: a PIN door, a PIN safe with repeated digits, a safe that opts out, the fingerprint kit and the PIN cracker on the lobby table. Nothing to solve beyond the codes.
test_objective: Prove the Dust action shows on a PIN pad only while the kit is held, greys every key that is not a digit of the PIN (repeated digits too), keeps it across a reload, respects dustable false, and works alongside the PIN cracker
